hints.content: The shape we see in the two-dimensional slice is a rectangle.

Which of the solids in the choices would produce a rectangular shape when sliced vertically? 

A vertical slice through the pyramids would produce a shape with sloping sides, not a rectangle.

Only the prism could produce the rectangular shape when sliced vertically.
